borman.name: Frank Borman
borman.description: Frank Borman was an American astronaut and commander of Apollo 8, the first crewed mission to orbit the Moon.

lovell.name: Jim Lovell
lovell.description: Jim Lovell was an American astronaut who flew on Apollo 8, Apollo 13, and several other space missions.

anders.name: William Anders
anders.description: William Anders was an American astronaut and lunar module pilot on Apollo 8.

stafford.name: Thomas Stafford
stafford.description: Thomas Stafford was an American astronaut who commanded Apollo 10 and helped prepare for the first Moon landing.

young.name: John Young
young.description: John Young was an American astronaut who flew on several space missions and commanded Apollo 16.

cernan.name: Eugene Cernan
cernan.description: Eugene Cernan was an American astronaut who commanded Apollo 17 and was the final person to walk on the Moon during the Apollo era.

armstrong.name: Neil Armstrong
armstrong.description: Neil Armstrong was an American astronaut and commander of Apollo 11. He was the first human to walk on the Moon.

aldrin.name: Buzz Aldrin
aldrin.description: Buzz Aldrin was an American astronaut and lunar module pilot on Apollo 11. He was the second person to walk on the Moon.

collins.name: Michael Collins
collins.description: Michael Collins was an American astronaut who served as command module pilot for Apollo 11 and remained in lunar orbit while Armstrong and Aldrin explored the Moon.

conrad.name: Pete Conrad
conrad.description: Pete Conrad was an American astronaut and commander of Apollo 12, the second mission to land humans on the Moon.

gordon.name: Richard Gordon
gordon.description: Richard Gordon was an American astronaut who served as command module pilot on Apollo 12.

bean.name: Alan Bean
bean.description: Alan Bean was an American astronaut and lunar module pilot on Apollo 12.

swigert.name: Jack Swigert
swigert.description: Jack Swigert was an American astronaut who served as command module pilot on Apollo 13.

haise.name: Fred Haise
haise.description: Fred Haise was an American astronaut and lunar module pilot on Apollo 13.

shepard.name: Alan Shepard
shepard.description: Alan Shepard was an American astronaut and commander of Apollo 14.

roosa.name: Stuart Roosa
roosa.description: Stuart Roosa was an American astronaut and command module pilot on Apollo 14.

mitchell.name: Edgar Mitchell
mitchell.description: Edgar Mitchell was an American astronaut and lunar module pilot on Apollo 14.

scott.name: David Scott
scott.description: David Scott was an American astronaut and commander of Apollo 15.

worden.name: Alfred Worden
worden.description: Alfred Worden was an American astronaut and command module pilot on Apollo 15.

irwin.name: James Irwin
irwin.description: James Irwin was an American astronaut and lunar module pilot on Apollo 15.

mattingly.name: Thomas Mattingly
mattingly.description: Thomas Mattingly was an American astronaut who served as command module pilot on Apollo 16.

duke.name: Charles Duke
duke.description: Charles Duke was an American astronaut and lunar module pilot on Apollo 16.

evans.name: Ronald Evans
evans.description: Ronald Evans was an American astronaut and command module pilot on Apollo 17.

schmitt.name: Harrison Schmitt
schmitt.description: Harrison Schmitt was an American astronaut and lunar module pilot on Apollo 17.
